fact: MIFOTRA with MINICT launched mandatory online AI training for all public servants, to be completed by 31 January 2026, with certificates uploaded to IPPIS and institutions submitting lists of trained staff to the National Public Service Commission by 15 February 2026.
title: Mandatory Artificial Intelligence (AI) Training for All Public Servants in Rwanda
publisher: Free Digital Opportunities (reproducing a MIFOTRA notice)
